The petitioners - accused Nos.1, 2 and 3 are before this Court calling in question the proceedings in S.C.No.1938/2019 registered for offences punishable under Sections 304B and 498A inter alia.

2. Learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 -the complainant submits that the petitioners have also filed application seeking their discharge from the array of accused in S.C.No.1938/2019 Venkata Subramanyan vs State Of Karnataka on 9 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167242660/
2 and the same is pending consideration.
3. In that light, I decline to entertain the petition leaving open the petitioners to pursue the remedy of discharge that the petitioners have availed of as on today.
4.

The petitioners - accused Nos.1, 2 and 3 are before this Court calling in question the proceedings in S.C.No.1938/2019 registered for offences punishable under Sections 304B and 498A inter alia.

All contentions are left open.
The application seeking discharge, if pending as on today, shall be expeditiously disposed, at any rate, within six weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
